title: Homer: Let the Barts Out
blurb: 'Let the Barts out!' — a Simpsons line that the internet extracted, isolated, and turned into pure absurdist nonsense. Out of context it means nothing; that's precisely why it works. The Simpsons has supplied meme material for thirty-five years and shows no sign of running dry. Release the Barts.
origin: An out-of-context line from The Simpsons.
